text_block_list.text:
Today,
Tracen Academy gymnasium buzzed with fervor.
The reason being——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Do not rush, keep the tempo steady!

text_block_list.name: Teammate
text_block_list.text: Roger!

Class multi-sport tournament was underway.
Duramente took the court for basketball.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Duramente.
That bloodline grants natural athletic
mastery across all disciplines.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Running point guard while racking up points……
Duramente commands the entire floor.

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Kh…… we can't let them pull away——Ah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
what a move……! Looks like a runaway victory!
Wonder what the final margin will be~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
…………Phew.
——All right, push up!

Everyone marveled at Duramente's play.
Yet beneath the surface,
tension tightened her brow.

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Deny the pass! Box her out right here!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer
text_block_list.text: ! No way, pulling up from there……?!
(——Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ——Rebound!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she missed……?
W-well, we still have the lead,
hang in there~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……My fault! Transition to defense!
Get it back!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: They won! Duramente-san delivered again!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Decisive victory.
Individual stats speak for themselves……
witnessed high caliber play today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……!
Trainer. You were watching……

Spectator cheers reached her ears.
Beneath them lay the relentless weight of
immense expectations.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Tension crept in.
A critical lapse in focus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——You are correct.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you! Looking for you,
Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Press reporter on feature assignment.
An interview was scheduled right after.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This offer came through my family, 
so no need to worry. ——Well then.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You stood out in that last race! 
However,
there were a few unfortunate incidents.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——Merely weakness in my own heart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This experience will strengthen my mental
resolve. 
So I remain calm in any situation.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——To prove I am the "Strongest".

Never hiding weakness,
constantly striving 
to improve. Unyielding under pressure——

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Growing stronger in body and mind! 
Expectations are high for your future
endeavors.

Watching her struggle through unease,
I resolve 
to stand by her side and support her through
it all.
